newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian share issuance heading for record year - BFC.
newsitem.headline: Belgian share issuance heading for record year - BFC.

text.p: The year 1996 is set to become a record one for share issues, the Belgian regulatory Banking and Finance Commission (BFC) said on Thursday.
By the end of September, a total 51.83 billion Belgian francs' worth of shares had been issued, nearly five times as many as the 11.80 billion worth issued in all of 1995.

"I think that we could see a total (share issuance) of 100 billion francs for full-year 1996," BFC chairman Jean-Louis Duplat told a news conference where he presented the BFC's 1995/96 annual report.

Duplat noted the September 1996 figure did not yet include the listing of bank Credit Communal de Belgique/Gemeentekrediet (CCB) in November, worth more than 30 billion francs, and several initial public offerings on the new Brussels-based pan-European EASDAQ market.
In 1994 a total 38.71 billon francs worth of shares was issued in Belgium and in 1993 a total 22.48 billion.
